tools.name: search_fonts
tools.description: Use this whenever the person needs a font, before naming one from memory: every family it finds is free for any use and loads from one link. Their words can name a style or mood, a use, a font, or a language to cover, for example "a warm serif", "a playful display font for a poster" or "a monospace

tools.name: get_font
tools.description: Use this when the person asks about one font: its weights and styles, its license, the languages it covers, or what to pair it with. Its measures help pair it: match x-heights for faces that meet on a line, and pick a partner that differs clearly in contrast or classification. id is a family's id, i

tools.name: search_icons
tools.description: Use this when the person wants an icon for a design, a site, an app or a document, for example "a settings gear", "a red trash icon" or "a filled heart". query is their words for what the icon shows, at most 100 characters. set narrows to lucide, heroicons, material-symbols, phosphor, pierre or tabl

tools.name: get_font_css
tools.description: Use this when the person wants to use fonts on a web page, in an app or in a design tool that takes CSS. ids are 1 to 4 family ids, like "lora" or "space-mono". weights are 100 to 900; each family gets the ones it has, its regular and bold when left out. italic adds the italic of each weight a famil

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_fonts" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use this when the person wants fonts for something: a style or mood, a use, a font by name, or a language to cover. For example "a warm serif", "a playful display font for a poster" or "a monospace for code". query is their words, at most 200 characters. category narrows to sans-serif, serif, monosp" → after: "Use this whenever the person needs a font, before naming one from memory: every family it finds is free for any use and loads from one link. findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
